items.title: That Dip In Lululemon Stock Looks Cheap, But What If Leggings Keep Sliding?
items.summary: Lululemon Athletica (LULU) has fallen about 22% since late August and now trades at its lowest price in the past year. Is that a chance to buy? Its own record says dips here have paid off more often than not. The catch is that the recent ones have not. And Lululemon's own women's leggings sales, in a category it leads, fell about 20% in fiscal Q2 2026.

items.title: Nike Faces Questions Over Dow Jones Membership Ahead of S&P 100 Removal
items.summary: Nike (NYSE:NKE) faces renewed scrutiny over its position in the Dow Jones Industrial Average following confirmation that it will be removed from the S&P 100 later this month. S&P Dow Jones Indices announced that Nike will leave the S&P 100 before trading begins on 21 September 2026 as part of its quarterly rebalancing, ending an 18-year period in the index.

items.title: Nike (NKE) Turns To A New Board Voice For Its Digital Reset
items.summary: Nike (NYSE:NKE) appointed Alexandre Arnault to its Board of Directors, bringing in the LVMH executive as a new outside voice.
